name: Summer internship in construction engineering and management
description: Comprehensive understanding of construction project execution, covering planning, scheduling, cost estimation, quality control, and safety management. Practical exposure to modern tools to enhance project efficiency. Engaged in real-world construction projects to observe and address practical challenges in project execution, technology integration, or site management. Develop problem-solving skills, analyze field data, and prepare a comprehensive technical report based on their observations and evaluations.
